name: Exhaust
description: Long-tube stainless headers (1-7/8 or 2 in) → V-band collectors → catted or test connection pipes with wideband O2 bungs → 3 in X-pipe → flex joints → 3 in mid pipes → race mufflers behind the axle → rear tips (side-exit option). Includes hangers, valve deletes, coatings and heat shields.

components.name: Factory ZL1 exhaust manifolds (reference, replaced)
components.description: The ZL1 LT4 uses unique cast "tri-Y" exhaust manifolds (Hot Rod). Removed in favor of long-tube headers on the race car; kept here for the torque reference and gasket part.
components.location: Exhaust ports on each cylinder head.

factory.name: GM ZL1 LT4 tri-Y exhaust manifolds
factory.notes: GM recommends replacing OE manifold bolts each removal (OEM bolt kit listing).

hardware.spec: M8 x 1.25 GM manifold bolt (per side; count approx.)
hardware.torqueSequence: First pass 11 ft-lb (15 N·m) all bolts center-out; final 20 ft-lb (27 N·m) new cylinder head / 17 ft-lb (23 N·m) used head

installNotes: Removed during build; retain for street conversion.

components.name: Long-tube headers (stainless, 1-7/8 or 2 in primaries)
components.description: Equal-length long-tube headers that replace the manifolds and scavenge each bank into a 3 in collector. Primary size: 1-7/8 in for most LT4 builds, 2 in for big-power/high-rpm engines. Must clear the Alpha front subframe, steering shaft and dry-sump pump (check before ordering—some headers are designed around the factory wet-sump pan).
components.location: From each cylinder head exhaust flange, down past the subframe, merging under the transmission bellhousing.

raceOptions.name: Kooks 1-7/8 x 3 in stainless long tubes w/ GREEN catted connection pipes (2016-24 SS / 2017-24 ZL1)
American Racing Headers long system 1-7/8 x 3 in with cats (2016+ SS/ZL1/1LE)
Stainless Works 2 in primaries, 3 in high-flow cats, X-pipe (2016-18 SS; ZL1 fitment listed)
Speed Engineering 2 in long tubes + 3 in X-pipe full kit (SS/ZL1)

hardware.spec: M8 x 1.25 x 25 mm (per side; supplied with GM gasket 12657093 or header kit)
hardware.torqueSequence: First pass 11 ft-lb (15 N·m) center-out; final 20 ft-lb (27 N·m) new head / 17 ft-lb (23 N·m) used head (GM manifold value applied to headers)
hardware.notes: Header makers may specify a different value (one Gen V gasket/bolt seller lists 18 ft-lb). Re-check after first heat cycle; safety-wire or use locking bolts on race cars.

installNotes: Install headers before the engine goes in only if the chassis/subframe allows—on the Alpha car they usually go in from below after engine install.
Check clearance to steering shaft, oil lines, fuel line, starter and dry-sump pump/hoses; maintain >= 1 in or add shields.
Wrap or ceramic-coat; sleeve nearby hoses and wiring.
inspection: Check flange bolts for loosening every event
Look for cracks at primaries/collector welds and at the flange
Check for exhaust leaks (black soot tracks)

components.name: Collector joints (V-band or slip/flange) and gaskets
components.description: Joint between header collector and the connection pipe. V-band flanges are preferred on race cars for quick removal and leak-free sealing; many street headers use ball/slip joints or 3-bolt flanges with donut gaskets.
components.location: At each collector outlet, under the bellhousing.
